name: Shrine Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health
timings: Main shrine open 24 hours from 3 Oct 2026 (was 5 AM–9 PM). Masses through the day in Tamil, English, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, Kannada and Konkani; morning prayer 5:40 AM.
closures: Open all year; expect very heavy crowds 29 Aug–8 Sep (annual feast), Holy Week and Christmas

booking.name: Shrine Basilica of Our Lady of Health, Vailankanni (official site)

dress_code: Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees
rules: Keep quiet if Mass is underway; sit at the back rather than walking the aisle
Confession is offered through the day with multilingual confessors
The annual feast procession and car festival are the busiest days of the year
best_time: November–February for cooler weather; 29 Aug–8 Sep for the feast if you want the pilgrimage (book stays weeks ahead)

festivals.name: Annual Feast of Our Lady of Good Health
festivals.when: 29 Aug–8 Sep every year (flag hoisting 29 Aug, grand feast 8 Sep)

reach.road: On the Nagapattinam coast; Nagapattinam town is about 12 km. Frequent buses from Chennai, Trichy and Thanjavur.
reach.local: The shrine, beach and tank are walkable; autos from the station and bus stand

avg_visit_time: 2–4 hours (a full day during the feast)
tips: Main shrine is 24 hours from Oct 2026, so late-night arrivals can pray inside
Chennai (MAA) is farther (~300 km) but has more flights than Trichy
Book rooms well before 29 Aug–8 Sep; 7 Sep night is the hardest to find a stay
People of other faiths commonly join the pilgrimage; dress modestly
notes: 24-hour opening of the main shrine was announced by the Bishop of Thanjavur for 3 Oct 2026 (The Hindu / Manorama). Confirm Mass language rooms on the shrine site. Airport km is an approximate road distance.

name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
timings: Weekdays 9:00 AM–6:30 PM; Sundays 10:30 AM–6:30 PM. Masses: weekdays 7:00 and 8:00 AM; Sundays 8:00 and 9:15 AM (Goa government / NRI Goa tourism).
closures: Open all year; expect queues around the feast of St Francis Xavier (3 Dec) and during relic expositions

booking.name: No ticket; ASI / Church of St Francis Xavier information

dress_code: Modest clothing; shoulders and knees covered
rules: This is a living church and a protected monument — keep voices low
The silver casket of St Francis Xavier is inside; follow staff directions around the relics
Combine with Se Cathedral, a short walk across the road
best_time: November–February; 3 December for the feast of St Francis Xavier

festivals.name: Exposition of the relics
festivals.when: Held roughly once a decade; last major exposition Dec 2024–Jan 2025

reach.road: About 10 km east of Panaji on the Old Goa road; also reachable from Madgaon (~25 km).
reach.local: Kadamba buses to Old Goa; taxis and hired scooters from Panaji

avg_visit_time: 45–90 minutes (half a day with the other Old Goa churches)
tips: Manohar International (GOX) is the newer North Goa airport; Dabolim is usually closer to Old Goa
Se Cathedral, Church of St Cajetan and the Archaeological Museum are within walking distance
Laterite façade photographs best in morning light
notes: Timings from the Government of Goa portal and NRI Goa tourism. Madgaon (MAO) is also used. Relic-exposition years are periodic, not annual.

name: National Shrine of St Thomas Cathedral Basilica
timings: Open 5:00 AM–8:00 PM daily (parish site). Sunday Mass in Tamil, English and Malayalam; weekday Mass 6:00 AM English, 11:00 AM and 6:00 PM Tamil (archdiocese shrine page).
rules: The tomb of St Thomas is in the crypt below the sanctuary — follow signs and keep silent
Photography rules inside the sanctuary can change; ask at the office
Office hours are typically 9:00 AM–1:00 PM
best_time: November–February; 3 July (feast of St Thomas) if you want the pilgrimage

festivals.name: Feast of St Thomas the Apostle

reach.road: On Santhome High Road along the Marina; 8 km south of Chennai Central.
reach.local: MRTS to Thirumayilai or Light House, then a short auto; buses along Kamarajar Salai

tips: Pair with St Thomas Mount (south-west Chennai) if you are following the apostle’s trail
Marina Beach is a 10-minute walk
Sundays are parish-busy; weekdays are calmer for the crypt
notes: Opening hours from santhomechurch.org. Mass-language list from the Archdiocese of Madras–Mylapore shrine page. Airport km is approximate.

name: Basilica of Our Lady of the Mount
timings: Basilica Masses: Sundays 6:30, 7:30, 8:30, 9:30 AM (no evening Mass on the official site); weekdays 6:30 and 7:30 AM. Visitor hours commonly 6 AM–about 8 PM; confirm at the basilica.
closures: Open all year; Bandra Fair week (around 8 Sep) is extremely crowded

booking.name: Basilica of Our Lady of the Mount, Bandra (official site)

rules: Keep quiet during Mass; the nave is a parish church, not only a viewpoint
The hill road is steep and parking is tight during the fair
best_time: November–February; September for Bandra Fair if you want the feast

festivals.name: Feast of the Nativity of Mary / Bandra Fair

reach.road: Mount Mary Road from Bandra West; taxis and autos from Bandra station and Linking Road.
reach.local: Walk or auto up the hill from St Andrews / Bandra market; the sea-facing steps are a short walk from the basilica

tips: Sunset over the Arabian Sea from the hill is the usual photograph
Bandra Fair stalls fill Mount Mary Road — go early or on a weekday
Official site currently lists no evening Mass; check before you plan around one
notes: Mass times from the basilica site. Some maps list 6 AM–1 PM; popular hours run later. Confirm visitor hours by phone (022-6501 0125).

name: St Thomas International Shrine, Malayattoor
timings: Daily pilgrimage on Kurisumudi 6:00 AM–4:00 PM; Lent, Holy Week and Thirunnal open day and night (official shrine). Mass: Sundays 5:00, 7:00, 9:00 AM and 5:15 PM; weekdays 6:00 AM and 5:15 PM.
closures: Open all year; the hill path can be closed or difficult in heavy monsoon
dress_code: Modest, comfortable clothes and shoes for the hill; many pilgrims go barefoot
rules: Fourteen Stations of the Cross mark the climb; keep to the path
Carry water; the hill is steep in the sun
There is also an ancient parish church by the Periyar at the foot of the hill
best_time: November–February; first Sunday after Easter (Malayattoor Perunnal) for the main feast

festivals.name: Malayattoor Perunnal
festivals.when: First Sunday after Easter (12 Apr 2026 if Easter is 5 Apr)

festivals.name: Feast of the Arrival of St Thomas in India

reach.road: About 15 km from Kalady; buses and taxis from Angamaly and Perumbavoor.
reach.local: Start at the riverside church; climb Kurisumudi on foot. Jeeps may run part-way in season.

trek.notes: Kurisumudi hill climb with 14 stations of the cross; distance is approximate

tips: Start early; 6 AM opening is the coolest climb
Lent and the week after Easter are the busiest
Combine with Kalady (Adi Shankara) if you are already on this side of the Periyar
notes: Hill hours and Mass times from malayattoorchurch.com. Trek km is not from an official measured trail — treat as a rough climb, not a surveyed distance. Elevation is the hill shrine, not the riverside parish.

name: St Francis CSI Church
timings: Weekdays commonly 9:00 AM–5:00 PM for visitors; Sunday worship 7:30 AM English and 10:00 AM Malayalam (church sites). Visitor access on Sunday is often after service, about 1:00–5:00 PM.
closures: Closed to casual visitors during Sunday morning service; ASI-protected monument

booking.name: St Francis CSI Church, Fort Kochi

rules: Still photography is usually allowed; video is often restricted (secondary guides — ask on site)
Vasco da Gama’s tombstone is inside; do not step on grave slabs
The Dutch cemetery nearby is maintained by the same church

reach.road: Fort Kochi is 13 km from Ernakulam; ferries from Ernakulam boat jetty, or road via Willingdon Island.
reach.local: Walkable from Fort Kochi bus stand, the Chinese fishing nets and Santa Cruz Basilica

tips: Santa Cruz Basilica is a few minutes’ walk if you want a living Catholic basilica as well
Weekday late morning is the busiest tourist window
Published visitor hours differ (9–5 vs 9–3 on one church page) — go in the morning to be safe
notes: Hours disagree slightly across the church’s own pages and tourism listings. Sunday morning is worship, not sightseeing. Airport km is approximate.

name: St Joseph's Cathedral (St Philomena's)
timings: Visitors 6:00 AM–8:00 PM daily (cathedral site). District tourism lists 8:00 AM–8:00 PM. Weekday Masses morning; Sundays several Masses in Tamil, Kannada and English.
closures: Open all year; Novena of St Philomena (2–10 Aug) is crowded

booking.name: St Philomena's Cathedral / Diocese of Mysore

dress_code: Modest, respectful attire; some visitors remove footwear in the sanctuary
rules: Photography is fine outside; be discreet inside, and do not photograph during Mass
The relic chapel / crypt is open for veneration through the day
If Mass is on, sit at the back and do not walk the nave

festivals.name: Novena and feast of St Philomena

reach.road: On Ashoka Road, Lourdes Nagar, about 1 km from the suburban bus stand. Bengaluru is ~140 km.
reach.local: Autos from the palace and railway station; parking on the grounds fills on Sundays

tips: Bengaluru (BLR) has far more flights than Mysore airport
Twin spires are ~52 m; morning light on the white Gothic façade is best
Pair with Mysore Palace, 2 km south
notes: Visitor hours 6 AM–8 PM from the cathedral site; 8 AM–8 PM from Mysuru district tourism. Mass-language lists on the same site vary between pages — confirm in the parish office.

name: Medak Cathedral
timings: Open for viewing and silent prayer about 6:00/7:00 AM–6:00 PM (church site vs district site). Sunday communion ~7:00 AM; general service ~9:30 or 10:00 AM.
rules: This is a Church of South India cathedral — keep silent prayer in the nave
Stained glass is the main reason to visit; go inside, not only the grounds
best_time: November–February; Christmas for the consecration anniversary (25 Dec 1924)

reach.road: About 95–100 km north of Hyderabad / Secunderabad; frequent TSRTC buses to Medak town.
reach.local: The cathedral is about 1.5 km from Medak bus stand in the mission compound

tips: Hyderabad is the practical airport; Medak has no station of its own
District tourism still quotes 7 AM–6 PM and Sunday services at 7:00 and 9:30 — the church site says 6 AM–6 PM and 10:00 AM general service
Allow a half-day from Hyderabad including the drive
notes: Opening and Sunday service times differ between medakchurch.com and medak.telangana.gov.in. Airport km is the usual Hyderabad figure (~100 km); RGIA is farther than the city (~146 km in one district page).

name: St Paul's Cathedral
timings: Visitors Mon–Sat 10:00 AM–6:00 PM; Sunday 12:00 noon–6:00 PM (official cathedral). Sunday worship from 7:30 AM (Eucharist, sung Eucharist, Bengali worship, evening Eucharist 6:00 PM).
closures: Open all year; visitor hours start after Sunday morning worship
rules: Visitor hours are separate from worship — on Sunday the nave opens to sightseers at noon
Keep quiet; this is the CNI mother church of Calcutta

airport.name: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport

reach.road: On Cathedral Road by the Maidan, next to the Victoria Memorial and Birla Planetarium.
reach.local: Metro to Maidan or Rabindra Sadan; taxis and buses along AJC Bose Road

tips: Walk across to Victoria Memorial in the same visit
Sunday sightseeing starts at noon so that morning worship is undisturbed
notes: Visitor hours from stpaulscathedralkolkata.org. Some maps list Sunday from 10 AM; the cathedral’s own visitor notice is noon–6 PM on Sunday.

name: Sacred Heart Cathedral
timings: Church commonly 6:00 AM–8:00 PM. Weekday Mass (Apr–Oct): 6:00 AM, 1:00 PM, 6:30 PM. Sunday: 6:30 AM English, 7:30 AM Malayalam, 9:00 AM English, 10:15 AM Hindi, 11:30 AM English (cathedral site, Apr–Oct 2026).
rules: Masses in English, Hindi and Malayalam — check the current weekly notice for winter vs summer times
The cathedral shares a campus with St Columba's School; follow entry directions
best_time: October–March; Christmas midnight Mass if you can get a seat

reach.road: 1 Ashok Place, Gol Dak Khana roundabout, a short walk from Connaught Place.
reach.local: Metro to Patel Chowk or Rajiv Chowk, then 10–15 minutes’ walk

tips: Winter Mass times (Nov–Mar) differ from the April–October list on the cathedral site
Office hours are split morning and evening on weekdays
Connaught Place is the easy landmark
notes: Mass schedule taken from sacredheartcathedraldelhi.org (April–October block). Winter list is posted as a separate notice each November.
